title: Without an expression, a filter on an unrelated table does not reduce the groups
query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Product[Color], FILTER ( Customer, Customer[Country] = "JP" ) )

source.quote: Since they're not directly related, the filter expression is a no-op and the groupBy columns are not impacted.
source.supports: the page shows this query shape: a filter on Customer with a group column of another dimension and no measure

derivation: Customer and Product are related only through Sales, so the Customer filter does not touch Product[Color]. All three colours are returned, although only Red and Blue were sold in JP.
